designAnswers.q2_connectedSurfaceScope: In scope at CampaignCoopRouteSurfaceConnected.tsx: the full ICampaign (prop, :66-70), campaignId/coopMode/roomCode/matchId (:72-75), the campaign store (:71; the same useCampaignStore the ledger page writes through), the pending entries (:83) whose fields are proposal {proposalId, campaignId, proposingPlayerId, ts, intent} (CoopCampaign.ts:101-112), balanceAtSubmit, relevantStanding, effectSummary (CampaignGmArbiter.ts:77-89), the host fold (:112-114), the host transport (getActiveCampaignSyncTransport, :340) and the runtime session (coopRuntimeSession.ts:133-137). Nothing in scope is an intervention ledger, a correction command or a preview.
designAnswers.q3_isProposalIdEnough: No. The ledger producers never take a proposal: createGmCascadePreview needs an IInterventionLedgerCommand (domain, kind, targetRefs, payload.correction family) and no code in src derives one from a guest proposal (grep of src/lib/interventions and src/components/campaign/gm for IGuestProposal|ICampaignIntent|proposalId|IPendingProposal = 0 lines). A proposal id identifies the pending entry and its intent, which is enough for a DIFFERENT producer: validateCampaignIntent (CampaignMatchHostIntent.ts:126-132, pure, covers all six intent kinds :146-236) is the check the authority runs at submit (CampaignGmArbiter.ts:421-437) and in the host commit doors (CampaignMatchHost.doors.ts:134, :161); it is not a producer the GM ledger route uses.
designAnswers.q4_manualTakeoverForAProposal: Per gm-campaign-intervention-boundaries spec.md:66-70 and :166-168, manual takeover is the path for a PREVIEW whose automatic cascade conflicts: the approval pipeline SHALL NOT append the intervention automatically. It presupposes a preview with conflicts; the ledger handler enforces that (ControlPlane :135-136, :326). For a pending guest proposal no spec says what it does, and the arbiter and wire know two decisions only: GmDecision approve | veto (CoopCampaign.ts:126), CampaignDecisionSchema decision z.enum([approve, veto]) (Protocol.ts:475-482), GmDecisionSchema (coopCampaignSchemas.ts:48-51); the transport sends proposal, decision, host intent and participation only (campaignSyncTransport.ts:34-39); the arbiter operations on a proposal are submitProposal, decide and autoVetoForTimeout (CampaignGmArbiter.ts:286, :347, :388). The ledger handler is not reusable as is: it is a closure inside the control plane (not exported), takes no argument, and returns without effect when the control plane holds no preview (:326).
designAnswers.q5_impossibleWithoutEditOutsideCoop: For the reading the charter's green rows state (each per-proposal button reaches the ledger's producer with the proposal id): all three are impossible from src/components/campaign/coop alone. The ledger producers are component-local closures (edit needed in src/components/campaign/gm to expose them), and even exposed they take no proposal (a semantic definition is missing, not only a path). Per-proposal manual takeover and GM correction additionally need a wire contract (Protocol.ts:475-482 and the schemas above). What IS possible inside coop: (A) mounting the ledger's whole control plane on the host dashboard (not per proposal), and (C1) a per-proposal preview through validateCampaignIntent (a producer the ledger route does not use).

readingOfTheSpecClause.clause: openspec/specs/coop-campaign-sync/spec.md:488-493: Requirement Co-op campaign command authority projection; Scenario Host sees authoritative campaign commands: the screen SHALL expose host-authorized preview, approve, veto, manual takeover, and GM correction controls for commands that affect campaign state.
readingOfTheSpecClause.readingTaken: per-screen and per-command: the controls are exposed ON the co-op command screen (here the dashboard) for the commands it shows. A navigation link is not taken as meeting it.
readingOfTheSpecClause.whyNotTheLink: The host dashboard already links to the ledger on the baseline: CampaignNavigation (mounted at CampaignDashboardPage.tsx:339-343) renders the GM Ledger tab for a host (CampaignNavigation.tsx:78, :166-171; campaignAuthority.ts:31-38 canUseGmControls true for mode host). Under the link reading the clause would already be met and U90 would change nothing. A per-row link would also be a proposal-labelled control that does nothing proposal-specific: gm-ledger.tsx:21-57 reads no query and its controls act on GM-authored canned corrections, and it has no distinct GM correction control.
readingOfTheSpecClause.whyTheSameProducersDoNotFitPerProposal: see q3 and q4: the ledger producers act on GM-authored corrections, never on a guest proposal.

blockingCause: The charter's green (each per-proposal control renders on the dashboard mount and one press reaches its producer once with the proposal's id) has no producer to wire: the GM ledger route's preview, manual takeover and correction are not proposal-scoped, not exported, and take no argument; no producer in src takes a guest proposal as the target of a manual takeover or GM correction, and the wire carries approve | veto only. Choosing what each control does to a pending proposal is an authority-class design decision, not wiring, and a unit is never widened while it is worked (GOAL.md:15).
